### Check url slug
GET /blogs/posts/url-slug-exists
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/blogs/posts/url-slug-exists
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/blogs/check-url-slug-exists | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/blogs/check-url-slug-exists.md

The "Check url slug" API checks whether a blog post url slug is already in use for the location. Call it before publishing a blog post.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: blogs/check-slug.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- urlSlug* string (e.g. "my-blog-post") - URL slug to check for uniqueness
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Sub-account (location) identifier the slug is being checked under
- postId string (e.g. "66c381b38be80858b9af62b6") - Identifier of the existing post to exclude from the uniqueness check

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- exists* boolean - Indicates whether the url slug exists or not

Errors: 400, 401, 404, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 404 (Not Found) application/json:
- statusCode number - HTTP status code for not found
- message string - Error message describing the not found failure
- error string - Error type identifier

### Get all blog authors
GET /blogs/authors
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/blogs/authors
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/blogs/get-all-blog-authors-by-location | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/blogs/get-all-blog-authors-by-location.md

The "Get all blog authors" API returns the blog authors for a given location ID.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: blogs/author.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Sub-account (location) identifier the author belongs to
- limit* number (e.g. 10) - Maximum number of authors to return (0-50)
- offset* number (e.g. 0) - Number of authors to skip before returning results
- searchTerm string (e.g. "jane") - Free-text search across author name and description

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- authors* object[] - Array of authors
  - locationId* string - Sub-account (location) identifier the author belongs to
  - name* string - Display name of the author
  - description string - Short biography or description of the author
  - role string - Role of the author within the blog (e.g., author, editor, contributor)
  - imageUrl string - Profile image URL for the author
  - imageAltText string - Alt text for the author profile image

    - url* string - URL of the social profile
    - type* string - Type of social platform
  - canonicalLink string - Canonical link override for the author profile page
  - _id* string - Identifier of the author
  - updatedAt string (format: date-time) - When the author was last updated
- count* number - Total number of authors matching the query, ignoring limit/offset

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
